panels.title: Prices · Latest Second
panels.description:
The newest second at which both legs and ${ref} have a trade price, whatever the time range (ten minutes back at most).

- **Phase**: US market phase now, in its band colour: Pre-Mkt, Regular, After-Hrs, Overnight · Closed: weekend or holiday.
- **${bull} Price**: Perp last trade price before the second, USDT.
- **${bull} Anchor**: The session's anchor, USD: the bell (F × Binance's index of the perp at the close; Bitget's before Binance lists the perp), then the issuer's NAV of that day once stable; less a dividend, or over a split's ratio, from the instant it takes effect.
- **${ref} Price**: Perp of ${ref}, the unleveraged ETF of the same index.
- **${ref} Return**: F·Price ÷ ${ref}'s bell anchor − 1, the bell adjusted from a dividend or split of ${ref}.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM (SELECT (SELECT CASE m[3] WHEN 'k' THEN 1000 WHEN 'w' THEN 10000 WHEN '万' THEN 10000 ELSE 1 END * (replace(m[1], ',', '') || m[2])::numeric FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$notional', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), 'u(sdt)?$', ''), '^([0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})+|[0-9]+)((?:[.][0-9]+)?)(k|w|万)?$') m) AS n, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::numeric > 0 THEN m[1]::numeric END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$d', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?)(?:bps)?$') m) AS d, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::integer > 0 THEN m[1]::integer END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$ma_minutes', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]{1,6})(?:min|m)?$') m) AS ma_n, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::integer > 0 THEN m[1]::integer END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$sigma_minutes', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]{1,6})(?:min|m)?$') m) AS sig_n) v),
     l AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x.* FROM v CROSS JOIN LATERAL etfpair.combo_last('$combo', '$venue', '$ma', v.ma_n, v.sig_n, v.n, v.d, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) x)
SELECT CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN (SELECT phase FROM etfpair.etf_phase WHERE start_ms <= (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint AND end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) END AS "Phase",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN p.p_bull END AS "Bull Price",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN (floor((p.a_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) END AS "Bull Anchor",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN p.p_bear END AS "Bear Price",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN (floor((p.a_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) END AS "Bear Anchor",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN p.p_ref END AS "Ref Price",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_ref / p.a_ref - 1))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) END AS "Ref Return",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.s_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.s_bps)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) ELSE -4000000000 END END AS "Spread",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.mu_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN b.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -6000000000 END END AS "Mean",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.sigma_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.sigma_bps)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN b.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -11000000000 END END AS "Sigma",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN abs(b.s_bps - b.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((abs(b.s_bps - b.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN b.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -6000000000 END END AS "Deviation",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN b.anchor_status END AS "Anchor Status",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN b.fx END AS "USD/USDT",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN b.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN b.s_long_bps < b.mu_bps THEN (floor((abs(b.s_long_bps - b.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN abs(b.s_long_bps - b.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN -10000000000 WHEN b.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN b.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Real Long Deviation",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN b.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN b.s_short_bps > b.mu_bps THEN (floor((abs(b.s_short_bps - b.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN abs(b.s_short_bps - b.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN -10000000000 WHEN b.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN b.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Real Short Deviation",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN b.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 WHEN NOT b.partial_long THEN -8000000000 WHEN b.filled_long IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.filled_long)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) ELSE -2000000000 END END AS "Long Fill",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN b.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 WHEN NOT b.partial_short THEN -8000000000 WHEN b.filled_short IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.filled_short)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) ELSE -2000000000 END END AS "Short Fill",
       CASE WHEN g.i = 1 THEN b.signal END AS "Signal",
       k.ticker AS "Leg",
       trim_scale(k.tick)::text AS "Tick",
       '1–' || etfpair.pricing_levels(k.tick) AS "Levels",
       CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.bid_ct_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.bid_ct_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END ELSE CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.bid_ct_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.bid_ct_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Bid · ct",
       CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.bid_usdt_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.bid_usdt_bull)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END ELSE CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.bid_usdt_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.bid_usdt_bear)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Bid · USDT",
       CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.ask_ct_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.ask_ct_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END ELSE CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.ask_ct_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.ask_ct_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Ask · ct",
       CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.ask_usdt_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.ask_usdt_bull)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END ELSE CASE WHEN b.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.ask_usdt_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((b.ask_usdt_bear)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT b.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END END AS "Ask · USDT"
FROM v LEFT JOIN l p ON p.kind = 'prices' LEFT JOIN l b ON b.kind = 'basis'
CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) g(i)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN c.bull_ticker ELSE c.bear_ticker END AS ticker, CASE g.i WHEN 1 THEN m.bull_tick ELSE m.bear_tick END AS tick
                   FROM etfpair.combo c JOIN etfpair.combo_market m ON m.combo_id = c.combo_id
                   WHERE c.combo_id = '$combo' AND m.venue = '$venue') k ON true
ORDER BY g.i

panels.title: Spread · Latest Second
panels.description:
The newest second at which both legs have a basis price: their books' mids, else their last trades (ten minutes back at most).

- **Spread**: 10⁴ × (F·P_bull ÷ A_bull + F·P_bear ÷ A_bear − 2) · P: both legs' mid prices, (best bid + best ask) ÷ 2 of the recorded book, else both last trades · A: anchor · F: USD/USDT.
- **Mean**: The same on each leg's ${ma:text} of its minute bars over the ${ma_text} min before, this session only · a bar: both legs' mids at the minute's end, else their trades, else their candle closes · No Mean: not ready, or Mean Scale is not a whole number of minutes.
- **Sigma**: σ: the population standard deviation of the minute bars' spread over the ${sigma_text} min before, this session only, as the trading program's (PRD 4.4) · No Sigma: not ready, or Sigma Scale is not a whole number of minutes.
- **Deviation**: |Spread − Mean|, absolute: its side is in the Signal.
- **Anchor Status**: NAV: both legs on the issuer's NAV, the same figure for 1 h · Bell: both legs on F × the perp's index at the close (Binance's; Bitget's before Binance lists it), provisional · Missing: no bell anchor yet, or none.
- **USD/USDT**: F, Coinbase USDT-USD.

panels.title: Signal · Latest Second · Notional ${n_text} USDT
panels.description:
The same second, at the notional N (USDT, both legs together); the deviations are absolute, each shown on the side of the Mean its real spread can fill on, as the bright lines of Entry Points · Bps (Other Side on the other), and the Signal gives the side.

- **Real Long Deviation**: |Real Long Spread − Mean| while Real Long Spread is below the Mean, the side a Long fills on · Other Side (grey): Real Long Spread at or above the Mean, where a Long cannot come (the tooltips still give |Real Long Spread − Mean| there) · Real Long Spread: the Spread on the average prices of buying both legs for N through their pricing levels' asks (open Long, close Short).
- **Real Short Deviation**: |Real Short Spread − Mean| while Real Short Spread is above the Mean, the side a Short fills on · Other Side: at or below the Mean · Real Short Spread: selling both legs for N through their pricing levels' bids (open Short, close Long).
- **Long Fill**: USDT of N the asks of both legs' pricing levels fill (${bull} 1–${bull_levels}, ${bear} 1–${bear_levels}), the quantities making q·A equal on both legs · Full: all of N · less where those levels hold less (Partial): the real spread is then on their totals, as Book · Latest Second shows them.
- **Short Fill**: The same on the pricing levels' bids.
- **Signal**: Long: Real Long Spread ≤ Mean − Entry · Short: Real Short Spread ≥ Mean + Entry · Partial: that side filled less than N (its pricing levels hold less) · None: inside · No Anchor: not ready · No Mean: not ready, or Mean Scale is not a whole number of minutes from 1 to 999,999 · No Book: not on both legs' books (trade prices, as before the recorder) · No Notional: the typed notional is not a positive number (the title shows ? or 0), amber · No Entry: Entry is not a positive number, amber · Past T: a leg's dividend took effect without its amount, amber, no signal until the amount is known.

panels.title: Book · Latest Second · Pricing Levels
panels.description:
Depth = the total of a leg's pricing levels on a side: ct (contracts, shares of the ETF) and USDT (Σ price × size)

The same second as the strips above · Tick: the leg's price tick on this CEX · Levels: its pricing levels, the first levels from the best price on the side a taker takes, as the trading program prices (PRD 3.2): 2 at a 0.01 tick (SOXL), 5 at 0.001 (Bitget SOXS), the levels as recorded, never merged into 0.01 ones · the Real spreads, the fills and the Signal take N through these levels only · the total, not the program's takeable half · No Book: no usable book of the leg in that second · Few Levels: that side holds fewer levels than its pricing levels (no pricing level).

panels.title: Trading Phases · UTC+8
panels.description:
Key to the bands behind every chart: each phase's current or next hours · no band while closed.

- **Pre-Market**: 04:00 – 09:30 New York.
- **Regular**: 09:30 – 16:00 New York, 13:00 on an early close.
- **After-Hours**: Four hours from the close.
- **Overnight**: 20:00 – 04:00 New York before a trading day.
- **Next Close**: The next regular close, the flatten deadline: 16:00 New York, 13:00 on an early close, as the calendar has it with its overrides.
- **Calendar**: The calendar against Binance's schedule, checked hourly: OK to the last day the schedule covers (New York date) · Differ: the first date whose trading day or close differs, without an override, and +n more · Not compared: the schedule could not be read or compared · amber unless OK · detail and check time in Calendar Check; extended hours are not compared here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp(start_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') || '–⁠' || to_char(to_timestamp(end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM etfpair.etf_phase WHERE phase = 'Pre-Market' AND end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint ORDER BY start_ms LIMIT 1) AS "Pre-Market",
       (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp(start_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') || '–⁠' || to_char(to_timestamp(end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM etfpair.etf_phase WHERE phase = 'Regular' AND end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint ORDER BY start_ms LIMIT 1) AS "Regular",
       (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp(start_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') || '–⁠' || to_char(to_timestamp(end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM etfpair.etf_phase WHERE phase = 'After-Hours' AND end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint ORDER BY start_ms LIMIT 1) AS "After-Hours",
       (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp(start_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') || '–⁠' || to_char(to_timestamp(end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM etfpair.etf_phase WHERE phase = 'Overnight' AND end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint ORDER BY start_ms LIMIT 1) AS "Overnight",
       (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp(min(close_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM etfpair.etf_session WHERE close_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS "Next Close",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN agree THEN 'OK to ' || to_char(to_timestamp((window_to_ms - 1) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'MM-DD') WHEN window_to_ms IS NULL THEN 'Not compared' ELSE (SELECT 'Differ · ' || substr(min(d[1]), 6) || CASE WHEN count(*) > 1 THEN ' +' || (count(*) - 1) ELSE '' END FROM regexp_matches(detail, '(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d):', 'g') d) END FROM etfpair.calendar_check) AS "Calendar"

panels.title: Next Actions · UTC+8
panels.description:
Each ETF's coming dividend or split, from the dates known ahead

Ex-Date: New York · Action: ex D (USD per share as declared, ? until a source gives it) or split r:1 · Takes Effect: a dividend at 20:00 New York of the day before the ex-date, the anchor then less D; a split at each CEX's first trade after its halt · Status: Scheduled (date only), Known, None (no distribution); Past T: it has taken effect, its amount still unknown, amber · Source: where the newest reading came from · it stays until the ex-date has passed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.ticker AS "ETF", to_char(a.ex_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ex-Date", CASE WHEN a.kind = 'dividend' THEN 'ex ' || coalesce(trim_scale(a.value)::text, '?') WHEN a.value >= 1 THEN 'split ' || trim_scale(a.value) || ':1' ELSE 'split 1:' || trim_scale(round(1 / a.value, 6)) END AS "Action",
       CASE WHEN a.kind = 'split' THEN 'after its halt'
            WHEN a.status <> 'None' THEN to_char(to_timestamp(s.start_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS "Takes Effect",
       a.status || CASE WHEN s.past_t THEN ' · Past T' ELSE '' END AS "Status", a.source AS "Source"
FROM etfpair.combo c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1, c.bull_ticker), (2, c.bear_ticker), (3, c.ref_ticker)) l(i, ticker)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT n.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (x.ex_date, x.kind) x.* FROM etfpair.etf_action x
                     WHERE x.ticker = l.ticker AND x.ex_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date ORDER BY x.ex_date, x.kind, x.known_ms DESC) n
    ORDER BY n.ex_date, n.kind LIMIT 1) a ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL etfpair.action_start(a.ex_date, a.status) s ON true
WHERE c.combo_id = '$combo' AND l.ticker <> ''
ORDER BY l.i

panels.title: Calendar Check · UTC+8
panels.description:
The latest hourly check of the calendar against Binance's schedule

Checked: when · Binance Through: the last day its schedule covers, New York · Result: OK, Differ (a trading day or close differs on a date without an override), Not compared (the schedule could not be read or compared), amber unless OK · Detail: the differences (here UTC+8 against Binance) or the reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(checked_ms / 1000.0) AS "Checked",
       to_char(to_timestamp((window_to_ms - 1) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'MM-DD') AS "Binance Through",
       CASE WHEN agree THEN 'OK' WHEN window_to_ms IS NULL THEN 'Not compared' ELSE 'Differ' END AS "Result", detail AS "Detail"
FROM etfpair.calendar_check

panels.title: Spread · ${ma:text} ${ma_text} min · σ ${sigma_text} min · Entry ${d_text} bps · Notional ${n_text} USDT (Both Legs)
Spread · Bps
panels.description:
Spread = 10⁴ × (F·P_bull ÷ A_bull + F·P_bear ÷ A_bear − 2) · P: both legs' mid prices, else both last trades · Real Long, Real Short Spread: the same on the average prices of buying, selling both legs for the notional N through their pricing levels' asks, bids · σ: the population standard deviation of the minute bars' spread over the Sigma Scale · Long: Real Long Spread ≤ Mean − Entry · Short: Real Short Spread ≥ Mean + Entry

Drawn: Spread, Mean, the band Mean ± Entry (teal, dashed; not drawn when Entry is not a positive number: the Signal reads No Entry) and Mean ± 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 σ (grey: whole σ dashed, half σ dotted; none until sigma is ready); the drawn Spread crossing a line is not a signal (see Deviation · Bps and Entry Points · Bps) · legend Sigma: σ's last, lowest and highest · tooltip, in this order: Spread, Real Long Spread, Real Short Spread, Mean, Sigma, Deviation, Real Long Deviation, Real Short Deviation, Signal, each leg's bid and ask depth of its pricing levels in ct (contracts) and USDT; each row is that second's value or the reason it has none (No Anchor, Past T, No Mean, No Sigma, No Notional, No Book, Few Levels) · P: (best bid + best ask) ÷ 2 of both legs' recorded books in that second, else both legs' last trades before it (before the recorder: trades only, No Book) · Real Long Spread, Real Short Spread: what opening or closing a basket of N USDT (both legs together) as a taker gives in that second, the quantities making q·A equal on both legs, through each leg's pricing levels only (${bull} 1–${bull_levels}, ${bear} 1–${bear_levels}: 2 at a 0.01 tick, 5 at 0.001, the trading program's, PRD 3.2); where those levels hold less than N, on their totals, and the Signal reads Partial · Deviation, Real Long Deviation, Real Short Deviation: |Spread − Mean|, |Real Long Spread − Mean|, |Real Short Spread − Mean|, absolute (with their signs on Deviation · Bps) · Signal: as in Signal · Latest Second · depth: as in Book · Latest Second · A: session anchor, less a dividend or over a split's ratio from the instant it takes effect (a mark there, with the expected and measured step; the mean and σ restart, also when a leg's dividend takes effect without its amount: A stays, the spread steps, Past T until the amount is known) · F: USD/USDT · Mean: the same on each leg's mean of its minute bars (both legs' mids at the minute's end, else their trades, else their candle closes) · each session is drawn on its own · points: the recorder's per-second rows, every second to about 83 min, 5 s to about 7 h, 10 s to about 14 h, 30 s to about 41 h, then every minute or more; a second without both legs' prices is a gap.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM (SELECT (SELECT CASE m[3] WHEN 'k' THEN 1000 WHEN 'w' THEN 10000 WHEN '万' THEN 10000 ELSE 1 END * (replace(m[1], ',', '') || m[2])::numeric FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$notional', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), 'u(sdt)?$', ''), '^([0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})+|[0-9]+)((?:[.][0-9]+)?)(k|w|万)?$') m) AS n, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::numeric > 0 THEN m[1]::numeric END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$d', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?)(?:bps)?$') m) AS d, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::integer > 0 THEN m[1]::integer END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$ma_minutes', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]{1,6})(?:min|m)?$') m) AS ma_n, (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::integer > 0 THEN m[1]::integer END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$sigma_minutes', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]{1,6})(?:min|m)?$') m) AS sig_n) v)
SELECT to_timestamp(r.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       (floor((r.s_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) AS "Spread",
       (floor((r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) AS "Mean",
       (floor((r.mu_bps + v.d)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) AS "Mean + Entry",
       (floor((r.mu_bps - v.d)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) AS "Mean − Entry",
       (floor((r.sigma_bps)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Sigma",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) ELSE -4000000000 END AS "Spread · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_long_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_long_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Real Long Spread",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_short_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_short_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Real Short Spread",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.mu_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -6000000000 END AS "Mean · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.sigma_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.sigma_bps)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -11000000000 END AS "Sigma · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN abs(r.s_bps - r.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((abs(r.s_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -6000000000 END AS "Deviation · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN abs(r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((abs(r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Real Long Deviation · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN abs(r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps) IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((abs(r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Real Short Deviation · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NOT NULL THEN CASE r.signal WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Long' THEN 1 WHEN 'Short' THEN 2 WHEN 'Long · Partial' THEN 3 WHEN 'Short · Partial' THEN 4 WHEN 'No Book' THEN -2000000000 WHEN 'No Notional' THEN -3000000000 WHEN 'No Anchor' THEN -4000000000 WHEN 'Past T' THEN -5000000000 WHEN 'No Mean' THEN -6000000000 WHEN 'No Entry' THEN -9000000000 END END AS "Signal",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.bid_ct_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.bid_ct_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Bid Bull ct",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.bid_ct_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.bid_ct_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Bid Bear ct",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.ask_ct_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.ask_ct_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Ask Bull ct",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.ask_ct_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.ask_ct_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Ask Bear ct",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.bid_usdt_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.bid_usdt_bull)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Bid Bull USDT",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.bid_usdt_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.bid_usdt_bear)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Bid Bear USDT",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.ask_usdt_bull IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.ask_usdt_bull)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bull THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Ask Bull USDT",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.ask_usdt_bear IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.ask_usdt_bear)::float8 * 1e0::float8 + 0.5) / 1e0::float8) WHEN NOT r.book_bear THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Ask Bear USDT",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((r.s_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Signed Deviation",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Signed Real Long Deviation",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Signed Real Short Deviation",
       CASE WHEN r.past_t THEN (floor((r.s_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Signed Past T",
       -v.d AS "−Entry",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps - r.mu_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 ELSE -6000000000 END AS "Signed Deviation · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Signed Real Long Deviation · Tooltip",
       CASE WHEN r.basis IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.s_bps IS NULL THEN -4000000000 WHEN r.past_t THEN -5000000000 WHEN r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps IS NOT NULL THEN (floor((r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) WHEN r.mu_bps IS NULL THEN -6000000000 WHEN NOT coalesce(v.n > 0, false) THEN -3000000000 WHEN r.basis <> 'mid' THEN -2000000000 ELSE -12000000000 END AS "Signed Real Short Deviation · Tooltip",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.signal LIKE 'Long%') OVER w AS "Long Points",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.signal LIKE 'Short%') OVER w AS "Short Points",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((abs(r.s_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Deviation · Line",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((abs(r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Real Long Deviation · Faded",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t THEN (floor((abs(r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Real Short Deviation · Faded",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t AND r.s_long_bps < r.mu_bps THEN (floor((abs(r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Real Long Deviation",
       CASE WHEN NOT r.past_t AND r.s_short_bps > r.mu_bps THEN (floor((abs(r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Real Short Deviation",
       CASE WHEN r.past_t THEN (floor((abs(r.s_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Past T",
       v.d AS "+Entry",
       CASE WHEN r.signal LIKE 'Long%' THEN (floor((abs(r.s_long_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Long Dots",
       CASE WHEN r.signal LIKE 'Short%' THEN (floor((abs(r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps))::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Short Dots",
       r.phase_sort AS "Phase",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL THEN (r.signal LIKE 'Long%')::integer END AS "Long Point",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL THEN (r.signal LIKE 'Short%')::integer END AS "Short Point",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL THEN (r.signal LIKE '% · Partial')::integer END AS "Partial Point",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL THEN (r.signal = 'Past T')::integer END AS "Past T Point",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL THEN (r.signal = 'No Book')::integer END AS "No Book Point",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL AND NOT r.past_t AND r.s_long_bps < r.mu_bps THEN (floor((r.mu_bps - r.s_long_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Best Long",
       CASE WHEN r.phase IS NOT NULL AND NOT r.past_t AND r.s_short_bps > r.mu_bps THEN (floor((r.s_short_bps - r.mu_bps)::float8 * 1e1::float8 + 0.5) / 1e1::float8) END AS "Best Short"
FROM v CROSS JOIN LATERAL etfpair.combo_range('$combo', '$venue', '$ma', v.ma_n, v.sig_n, $__from, $__to, (SELECT CASE WHEN r <= 1000 THEN 1000 WHEN r <= 5000 THEN 5000 WHEN r <= 10000 THEN 10000 WHEN r <= 30000 THEN 30000 ELSE ceil(r / 60000) * 60000 END::bigint FROM (SELECT ($__to - $__from) / 5000.0 AS r) x), v.n, v.d) r
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY r.ts_ms)
ORDER BY r.ts_ms

panels.title: Deviation · Bps
panels.description:
Deviation = Spread − Mean · Real Long / Short Deviation = Real Long / Short Spread − Mean · Long: Real Long Deviation ≤ −Entry · Short: Real Short Deviation ≥ +Entry · ±k σ: k times sigma, k = 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3

The Spread chart with its Mean at zero, with signs · purple: Deviation on the mids (trades where there is no book; the only line before the recorder) · blue: Real Long Deviation, buying both legs for N through their pricing levels' asks, never below purple · orange: Real Short Deviation, selling through the bids, never above it · a Long needs blue at or under −Entry (blue dashed), a Short orange at or over +Entry (orange dashed), Partial included; blue over +Entry or orange under −Entry is no signal · grey: ±1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 σ (whole σ dashed, half σ dotted), the trading program's lines are d_in·σ: where blue reaches −2σ, x ≤ −2σ · legend Min of blue, Max of orange: how far each side came toward or past its Entry (Entry Points' Best); Sigma: σ's last, lowest and highest, k σ is k times it · tooltip: each second's value or why it has none, σ, and the Signal · Past T (amber): no signal until the dividend's amount is known · no band with No Entry, no σ lines with No Sigma · absolute values and signal dots: Entry Points · Bps.

panels.title: Entry Points · Bps
panels.description:
Deviation = |Spread − Mean| · Real Long Deviation = |Real Long Spread − Mean| · Real Short Deviation = |Real Short Spread − Mean| · Long: Real Long Spread ≤ Mean − Entry · Short: Real Short Spread ≥ Mean + Entry

All three are absolute (with their signs: Deviation · Bps); each real line is bright on the side of the Mean its real spread can fill on and faded on the other: Real Long Deviation (blue) bright while Real Long Spread is below the Mean, Real Short Deviation (orange) bright while Real Short Spread is above it, so a bright line above Entry (teal dashed) is a signal of its side and a faded one is none (Signal · Latest Second shows a faded side as Other Side) · grey: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 σ (whole σ dashed, half σ dotted) · Long Points, Short Points: a dot on the blue, orange line at each drawn second whose Signal is Long, Short (Partial included), counted in the legend · Real Long, Real Short Deviation: buying, selling both legs for the notional through their pricing levels, the Signal's spreads; none without both legs' books · Deviation (grey): on the basis prices, the only line before the recorder · legend Max: the largest value of each bright line (Entry Points' Best of the range), the counts in the range · tooltip: each row is that second's value, absolute whatever its side, or the reason it has none (No Anchor, Past T, No Mean, No Notional, No Book, Few Levels), and the Signal · No Entry (Entry not a positive number): no Entry line, no dots · empty until the session's mean is ready, and with no valid Mean Scale · Past T, amber: the deviation from the instant a leg's dividend takes effect without its amount until it is known, no signal and not counted · points are coarser on longer ranges, so counts do not compare across ranges.

panels.title: Entry Points by Phase · Bps
panels.description:
Long Points: Real Long Spread ≤ Mean − Entry · Short Points: Real Short Spread ≥ Mean + Entry · Best: the largest absolute deviation on the favourable side

The drawn points of the time range with a deviation, by the US market phase they fall in, counted as the Signal reads them, at the notional (none Long, Short or No Book with No Entry or No Notional) · Partial Points: Long and Short points whose side the recorded levels filled less than N, already in Long Points and Short Points · Best Long: the largest Real Long Deviation of the points whose Real Long Spread is below the Mean, Best Short: the largest Real Short Deviation of those whose Real Short Spread is above it (the legend Max of the bright lines on Entry Points · Bps); how far each side came toward or past its Entry (not past T; – where none) · Past T Points: points past the instant a leg's dividend took effect without its amount, amber · No Book Points: points without both legs' books (on trade prices) · these two are in neither Long nor Short Points · Points: every point with a deviation, these included · counts depend on the range, as in the chart.

panels.title: ${bull} Price · USDT
panels.description:
Return = Price ÷ Anchor (USDT) − 1 · Anchor (USDT) = Anchor (USD) ÷ F

Price: perp last trade as of each point's time, at the seconds both legs have one, none during a split's halt · Anchor (USD): the session's anchor, the bell, F × Binance's index of the perp at the close (Bitget's before Binance lists the perp), replaced for the whole session by the issuer's NAV once stable; less a dividend, or over a split's ratio, from the instant it takes effect; legend and tooltip only · Anchor (USDT): the price where Return is 0, moves slightly with F · F: USD/USDT · Return: right axis, %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(p.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
       p.p_bull AS "Bull Price",
       (floor((p.a_bull / p.fx)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Anchor (USDT)",
       (floor((p.a_bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Anchor (USD)",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_bull / p.a_bull - 1))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Return",
       p.p_bear AS "Bear Price",
       (floor((p.a_bear / p.fx)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Anchor (USDT)",
       (floor((p.a_bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Anchor (USD)",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_bear / p.a_bear - 1))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Return",
       p.p_ref AS "Ref Price",
       (floor((p.a_ref / p.fx)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Ref Anchor (USDT)",
       (floor((p.a_ref)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Ref Anchor (USD)",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_ref / p.a_ref - 1))::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Ref Return",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_bull / p.a_bull + p.fx * p.p_bear / p.a_bear - 2) / 3)::float8 * 1e3::float8 + 0.5) / 1e3::float8) AS "Sum",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_bull / p.a_bull - 1) / 3)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Leg",
       (floor((100 * (p.fx * p.p_bear / p.a_bear - 1) / 3)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Leg"
FROM etfpair.combo_prices('$combo', '$venue', $__from, $__to, (SELECT CASE WHEN r <= 1000 THEN 1000 WHEN r <= 5000 THEN 5000 WHEN r <= 10000 THEN 10000 WHEN r <= 30000 THEN 30000 ELSE ceil(r / 60000) * 60000 END::bigint FROM (SELECT ($__to - $__from) / 5000.0 AS r) x)) p
ORDER BY p.ts_ms

panels.title: ${bear} Price · USDT
panels.description:
Return = Price ÷ Anchor (USDT) − 1 · Anchor (USDT) = Anchor (USD) ÷ F

Price: perp last trade as of each point's time, at the seconds both legs have one, none during a split's halt · Anchor (USD): the session's anchor, the bell, F × Binance's index of the perp at the close (Bitget's before Binance lists the perp), replaced for the whole session by the issuer's NAV once stable; less a dividend, or over a split's ratio, from the instant it takes effect; legend and tooltip only · Anchor (USDT): the price where Return is 0, moves slightly with F · F: USD/USDT · Return: right axis, %.

panels.title: ${ref} Price · USDT
panels.description:
Return = Price ÷ Anchor (USDT) − 1 · Anchor (USDT) = Anchor (USD) ÷ F

Price: perp last trade as of each point's time, at the seconds both legs have one, none during a split's halt · Anchor (USD): the session's anchor, the bell, F × Binance's index of the perp at the close (Bitget's before Binance lists the perp); less a dividend, or over a split's ratio, from the instant it takes effect; legend and tooltip only · Anchor (USDT): the price where Return is 0, moves slightly with F · F: USD/USDT · Return: right axis, % · ${ref}: the unleveraged ETF of the same index.

panels.title: Implied Return · %
panels.description:
Bull Leg = (F·p_bull ÷ A_bull − 1) ÷ 3 · Bear Leg = (F·p_bear ÷ A_bear − 1) ÷ 3 · Sum = Bull Leg + Bear Leg

The index return each leg implies since the close, on the perps' last trades · Sum: the spread on those trades ÷ 3 in % (0.01 % = 1 bps), right axis; the drawn Spread is on mid prices, apart from it by the trades against the mids · Reference: ${ref}'s own return · each on its anchor less a dividend, or over a split's ratio, from the instant it takes effect.

panels.title: Fee Levels · ${venue:text} · Bps
panels.description:
Breakeven Entry = 2 × Taker · Net at Entry = Entry − Breakeven Entry

One round trip across the band, bps of both legs' notional: four taker fills; the Signal is on the real spreads of the notional, so crossing the spread and going down the levels are inside it · Half Spreads: both legs' half spreads in the newest second with a book of both, what crossing the best levels costs now · Net at Entry: – when Entry is not a positive number · funding not included.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.label AS "Level", f.taker_bps AS "Taker", c.half_bps AS "Half Spreads",
       2 * f.taker_bps AS "Breakeven Entry", v.d - 2 * f.taker_bps AS "Net at Entry", f.source AS "Source"
FROM etfpair.fee_level f
CROSS JOIN (SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::numeric > 0 THEN m[1]::numeric END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$d', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?)(?:bps)?$') m) AS d) v
LEFT JOIN (SELECT 10000 * ((b.ask_px[1] - b.bid_px[1]) / (b.ask_px[1] + b.bid_px[1]) + (s.ask_px[1] - s.bid_px[1]) / (s.ask_px[1] + s.bid_px[1])) AS half_bps
           FROM etfpair.combo_market k
           JOIN etfpair.perp_second b ON b.venue = k.venue AND b.symbol = k.bull_symbol
           JOIN etfpair.perp_second s ON s.venue = k.venue AND s.symbol = k.bear_symbol AND s.second_ms = b.second_ms
           WHERE k.combo_id = '$combo' AND k.venue = '$venue' AND b.second_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 600000
             AND b.bid_px[1] IS NOT NULL AND b.ask_px[1] IS NOT NULL AND s.bid_px[1] IS NOT NULL AND s.ask_px[1] IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY b.second_ms DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
WHERE f.venue = '$venue' ORDER BY f.sort

panels.title: Anchors · Bell and NAV
panels.description:
Anchor = both legs' NAV once the issuer has given the same figure for 1 h, else both legs' Bell = F × the perp's index at the close

Session: the New York day whose close starts it · Bell: F × the close of the perp's one-minute index kline that ends at the close, Binance's, or Bitget's before Binance lists the perp, USD · NAV: the issuer's current figure · Known Time: when the anchor in use became known (a bell filled in later: close + 2 min; a NAV loaded from the issuer's history: its load time) · Missing: no bell anchor yet, or none · Actions: the session's dividends (ex, USD as declared) and splits, when each takes effect on this CEX and its status: Scheduled, Known, None (no instant), then Applied, Verified, Mismatch, and known MM-DD HH:MM when the amount came after that instant; amber: Mismatch, or Past T without an amount · anchors shown are the session's start, before an action; coming actions: Next Actions · times UTC+8.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(cs.session_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Session", to_timestamp(cs.close_ms / 1000.0) AS "Close Time",
       cs.bell_bull AS "${bull} Bell", cs.bell_bear AS "${bear} Bell", cs.a_ref AS "${ref} Bell", cs.nav_bull AS "${bull} NAV", cs.nav_bear AS "${bear} NAV",
       cs.a_bull AS "${bull} Anchor", cs.a_bear AS "${bear} Anchor", to_timestamp(cs.known_ms / 1000.0) AS "Known Time",
       cs.status AS "Status", ac.actions AS "Actions"
FROM etfpair.combo_sessions('$combo') cs
LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.session_date, string_agg(a.ticker || ' ' || CASE WHEN a.kind = 'dividend' THEN 'ex ' || coalesce(trim_scale(a.value)::text, '?') WHEN a.value >= 1 THEN 'split ' || trim_scale(a.value) || ':1' ELSE 'split 1:' || trim_scale(round(1 / a.value, 6)) END || coalesce(' · ' || to_char(to_timestamp(CASE WHEN a.status <> 'None' THEN a.effective_ms END / 1000.0)
                                                                                  AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM-DD HH24:MI'), '') || ' · ' || a.shown
                                             || coalesce(' · known ' || to_char(to_timestamp(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Known' AND a.known_ms > a.effective_ms
                                                                                              THEN a.known_ms END / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM-DD HH24:MI'), ''),
                                             '; ' ORDER BY a.ex_date, a.ticker) AS actions
           FROM etfpair.combo_actions('$combo', '$venue') a GROUP BY a.session_date) ac ON ac.session_date = cs.session_date
WHERE cs.close_ms <= extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000
ORDER BY cs.close_ms DESC LIMIT 6

panels.title: Data Coverage · Time Range
panels.description:
Missing Minutes = minutes of the range without a candle close · Book Age = seconds since the newest second with a book

Seconds: the recorder's per-second rows with a last price, which give the points and the mean's minute bars · Book Seconds: those with a best bid and a best ask · Levels: the fewest levels the thinner side and the most the deeper side of those books held, the depth the real spreads can take (Bitget SOXS: 5 until 11-20 18:43, 10 until 11-22 12:16, 50 since; Binance SOXL, SOXS: 1 from 11-19 19:15 to 11-20 18:43) · Candle Minutes: the exchanges' one-minute candles, the mean's bar only where a minute's end has neither both legs' books nor both legs' trades; a minute without any bar restarts the mean · Book Age amber from 60 s, red from 300 s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.symbol AS "Contract", m.minutes AS "Candle Minutes",
       least($__to, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) / 60000 - ($__from + 59999) / 60000 - m.minutes AS "Missing Minutes",
       p.seconds AS "Seconds", p.books AS "Book Seconds",
       CASE WHEN p.least_levels = p.most_levels THEN p.least_levels::text ELSE p.least_levels || '–' || p.most_levels END AS "Levels",
       round(extract(epoch FROM now()) - (SELECT t.second_ms FROM etfpair.perp_second t WHERE t.venue = k.venue AND t.symbol = k.symbol
                                          AND t.bid_px[1] IS NOT NULL AND t.ask_px[1] IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.second_ms DESC LIMIT 1) / 1000.0) AS "Book Age s"
FROM (SELECT m.venue, u.symbol, u.leg FROM etfpair.combo_market m, unnest(ARRAY[m.bull_symbol, m.bear_symbol, m.ref_symbol]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(symbol, leg)
      WHERE m.combo_id = '$combo' AND m.venue = '$venue') k
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS minutes FROM etfpair.perp_minute m
                    WHERE m.venue = k.venue AND m.symbol = k.symbol AND m.minute_ms >= $__from AND m.minute_ms + 60000 <= least($__to, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)) m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL etfpair.perp_coverage(k.venue, k.symbol, $__from, least($__to, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)) p
ORDER BY k.leg

list.name: combo
list.label: Combo
list.description: The bull and bear ETF perps traded as one basket.
list.definition: SELECT title AS __text, combo_id AS __value FROM etfpair.combo ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT title AS __text, combo_id AS __value FROM etfpair.combo ORDER BY 1

list.name: venue
list.label: CEX
list.description: The exchange whose perps price the combo.
list.definition: SELECT initcap(venue) AS __text, venue AS __value FROM etfpair.combo_market WHERE combo_id = '$combo' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT initcap(venue) AS __text, venue AS __value FROM etfpair.combo_market WHERE combo_id = '$combo' ORDER BY 1

list.name: ma
list.label: EMA/SMA
list.description: SMA: plain average · EMA: alpha = 2 ÷ (Mean Scale + 1).

list.name: ma_minutes
list.label: Mean Scale (min)
list.description: Minutes the mean covers, a whole number from 1 to 999,999 (60, 60min); it restarts at each close · anything else: no mean, the Mean, the deviations and the Signal read No Mean.

list.name: sigma_minutes
list.label: Sigma Scale (min)
list.description: Minutes sigma covers: the population standard deviation of the minute bars' spread over that many minutes, a whole number from 1 to 999,999 (60, 60min); it restarts with the mean · anything else: no sigma lines, Sigma reads No Sigma.

list.name: d
list.label: Entry (bps)
list.description: Long: Real Long Spread ≤ Mean − Entry · Short: Real Short Spread ≥ Mean + Entry · a positive number (10, 7.5, 10bps); anything else: the Signal reads No Entry and Mean ± Entry is not drawn.

list.name: notional
list.label: Notional (USDT)
list.description: N, both legs together: the Real spreads and the Signal fill N through both legs' pricing levels (2 at a 0.01 tick, 5 at 0.001), on their totals where they hold less (Partial) · pick one or type any amount and press Enter: 2000, 20,000, 20k, 2万, 20000U · the options are written 1k to 100k, so a typed number of four digits or more never picks one; only 1 to 99 (contained in 100 or 500) need a U (50U) · the titles show the N in use.

list.name: n_text
list.label: Notional in Use
list.definition: SELECT coalesce(rtrim(rtrim(to_char((SELECT CASE m[3] WHEN 'k' THEN 1000 WHEN 'w' THEN 10000 WHEN '万' THEN 10000 ELSE 1 END * (replace(m[1], ',', '') || m[2])::numeric FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$notional', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), 'u(sdt)?$', ''), '^([0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})+|[0-9]+)((?:[.][0-9]+)?)(k|w|万)?$') m), 'FM999,999,999,999,990.999999'), '0'), '.'), '?')
list.query: SELECT coalesce(rtrim(rtrim(to_char((SELECT CASE m[3] WHEN 'k' THEN 1000 WHEN 'w' THEN 10000 WHEN '万' THEN 10000 ELSE 1 END * (replace(m[1], ',', '') || m[2])::numeric FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$notional', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), 'u(sdt)?$', ''), '^([0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})+|[0-9]+)((?:[.][0-9]+)?)(k|w|万)?$') m), 'FM999,999,999,999,990.999999'), '0'), '.'), '?')

list.name: d_text

list.query: SELECT coalesce(rtrim(rtrim(to_char((SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::numeric > 0 THEN m[1]::numeric END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$d', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]+)?)(?:bps)?$') m), 'FM999,999,990.999999'), '0'), '.'), '?')

list.query: SELECT coalesce(((SELECT CASE WHEN m[1]::integer > 0 THEN m[1]::integer END FROM regexp_match(regexp_replace(lower(normalize('$ma_minutes', NFKC)), '[[:space:]_]', '', 'g'), '^([0-9]{1,6})(?:min|m)?$') m))::text, '?')

list.name: Corporate Actions
list.rawQuery:
SELECT a.effective_ms AS time, string_agg(a.ticker || ' ' || CASE WHEN a.kind = 'dividend' THEN 'ex ' || coalesce(trim_scale(a.value)::text, '?') WHEN a.value >= 1 THEN 'split ' || trim_scale(a.value) || ':1' ELSE 'split 1:' || trim_scale(round(1 / a.value, 6)) END || coalesce(' · expected ' || round(a.expected, CASE a.kind WHEN 'dividend' THEN 1 ELSE 4 END) || CASE a.kind WHEN 'dividend' THEN ' bps' ELSE ' log' END, '') || CASE WHEN a.status = 'Known' THEN ' · measured ' || coalesce(round(a.observed, CASE a.kind WHEN 'dividend' THEN 1 ELSE 4 END) || CASE a.kind WHEN 'dividend' THEN ' bps' ELSE ' log' END, '–') || coalesce(' · NAV check ' || round(a.nav_bps, 1) || ' bps', '') ELSE '' END || ' · ' || a.shown, '; ' ORDER BY a.ticker, a.kind) AS text
FROM etfpair.combo_actions('$combo', '$venue') a
WHERE a.status <> 'None' AND a.effective_ms > $__from AND a.effective_ms <= $__to
GROUP BY a.effective_ms
